description: Drive a local ComfyUI render server from the shell, with a durable record of every run the server itself forgets.

novel_features.name: Idempotent submit lease
novel_features.description: Submitting a graph that is already rendering attaches to the running job instead of starting a second one.

novel_features.name: Model visibility triage
novel_features.description: Says why ComfyUI cannot see a model file, separating four causes that every other tool collapses into one.

novel_features.name: COMBO option values
novel_features.description: Prints the values a loader input will actually accept, reading both /object_info spec shapes.

novel_features.name: Guarded slot patching
novel_features.description: Applies overrides to a graph's inputs, refusing to write when a node no longer holds the class it did when the address was captured.

novel_features.name: Offline preflight
novel_features.description: Checks a graph against the cached node schema before submitting — unknown classes, missing required inputs, and COMBO values that are not members of the option list.

novel_features.name: Honest run timing
novel_features.description: Reports duration from the server's own execution timestamps, compared against the historical distribution for the same graph shape.

novel_features.name: Durable history ingest
novel_features.description: Copies the server's in-memory render history into the local store before a restart destroys it.

novel_features.name: Multi-arm experiments
novel_features.description: Runs a parameter sweep as one durable object, with failed arms recorded as first-class rows rather than gaps.

novel_features.name: Output provenance
novel_features.description: Given a produced file, reports the run, graph, experiment arm, timing, server identity, and staged input that made it.

novel_features.name: Stable input identity
novel_features.description: Stages a host file into ComfyUI's input directory and records its content hash, so archived runs stay reproducible.

novel_features.name: Attributed replay
novel_features.description: Re-runs a stored graph and reports a before/after delta including which server configuration each ran under.

novel_features.name: Probed output properties
novel_features.description: Lists produced files and, with --probe, fills in resolution, frame rate, duration, and whether audio is present.
